fatal_errors: The hypothesis targets HfNbTiVAl10 and tensile/fracture-property prediction, whereas the target study concerns composition screening in the Nb-Mo-Ta-V-W system and room-temperature compression of Nb15Mo2.5Ta40V40W2.5.

It replaces the target intervention—validation of rule-of-mixtures modulus estimates followed by screening 38,326 compositions using modulus, VEC, and density—with an unsupported CALPHAD/first-principles machine-learning model.
The proposed mechanism omits the target VEC-mediated reduction of the Peierls–Nabarro barrier, enhanced dislocation mobility, slip development, delayed cracking, and work hardening.
The claimed 20–30% accuracy gain and 30–50% computational reduction are unsupported by evidence or defined error metrics.
No supporting prior evidence is cited despite the explicit request.
The benchmark does not test the target comparison against equimolar as-cast NbMoTaVW under quasi-static room-temperature compression.
explanation: There is only superficial alignment in addressing mechanical-property prediction and proposing a prospective test. The hidden study instead used a simple, computationally efficient composition-screening strategy: modulus-model validation on roughly 130–132 HEAs, exhaustive screening of 38,326 Nb-Mo-Ta-V-W compositions, and selection of a low-VEC alloy retaining relatively high predicted modulus. It then experimentally demonstrated a single-phase BCC as-cast alloy with 35.7 ± 0.9% compressive fracture strain, 1115 ± 18 MPa yield strength, and 2550 ± 75 MPa compressive strength. None of these intervention details, conditions, mechanisms, baselines, or outcomes is reconstructed. The proposed blinded benchmark has some falsifiability because it names measurements and numerical thresholds, but it lacks a prespecified dataset, train/test separation, error metric, sample count, comparator implementation, and evidence-based thresholds. Its generic out-of-distribution boundary is reasonable in isolation but does not capture the target method's specific limitation that modulus, VEC, and density omit phases, grain size, defects, and processing history.
